_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Add grow-only scratch arrays, tracked one-shot delays, and sprite pixel bounds with flip and transformed-corner helpers ([#1113](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1113)).
- Add test report source-freshness diagnostics across transitive assembly references, with named stale sources and missing-input reports ([#1112](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1112)).
- Add nonempty collection and nondefault value checks to `AuthoredRequirementValidator`, with explicit requirement kinds and project-owned annotations ([#1112](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1112)).
- Add `Objects.StableHash64V1` for standard 64-bit FNV-1a byte hashes with a frozen algorithm and optional seed ([#1112](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1112)).
- Add automatic `LiveComponents<T>` discovery by component class, base class or interface, with active and scene queries and reusable result lists ([guide](./docs/features/utilities/helper-utilities.md#live-component-registries), [#1110](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1110)).
- Add `WUH026` to report bitwise boolean operators, with guidance for preserving required calls and nullable results ([#1092](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1092)).
- Add `WUH025` compiler diagnostics for unsupported relational field types, with an Analyzer Policies severity control to reject invalid declarations before runtime. ([#1086](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1086)).
- Add opt-in `WUH024` suggestions for typed enum flag checks and cached enum names, with semantic guards and Analyzer Policies examples ([guide](./docs/performance/analyzers.md#wuh024-typed-enum-helpers-opt-in), [#917](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/917)).
- Add an opt-in WProto allowance that refuses generated class construction before constructors run. Regenerate codecs to enforce it; custom allocations remain separate ([#1042](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1042)).
- Add an opt-in WProto element allowance shared by collection reads, nested values, maps and reader copies. Regenerate collection codecs to enforce it ([#1040](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1040)).
- Add an opt-in WProto decoded payload allowance shared across strings, byte arrays, URIs, nested reads, and reader copies. Regenerate byte-array member codecs to enforce it ([#1038](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1038)).
- Add an opt-in total-field read limit for WProto, shared across nested messages, duplicate-message validation, unknown fields, groups, and reader copies while preserving existing per-message limits ([#647](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/647)).
- Add typed equality and hashing to public value types, including configurations, scopes, enumerators, and protobuf surrogates, plus the opt-in `WUH023` analyzer ([#1001](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1001)).
- Add `TryGetInstance(out T)` to both singleton families for reading an existing instance without creating, searching, or loading one ([#1009](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/1009)).
- Add generated protobuf roots for supported arrays, lists, and dictionaries, including object/interface writes, explicit-type reads, and readonly generic consumer values. Generated maps retain nullable keys and values, including present defaults ([#343](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/343)).
- Add Odin migration APIs with paired previews, cross-assembly capture, private and readonly fields, isolated compilation, and recoverable source/data apply preserving null and shared lists. Keep compiler markers safe to reference in player builds ([guide](./docs/guides/odin-migration-guide.md#programmatic-migration), [#794](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/794)).
- Add `SceneCanonicalizer` for stable generated scenes and prefabs, including legacy prefab sibling order, local reference remapping, Unity-reserved ID avoidance and opt-in folder imports ([guide](./docs/features/editor-tools/scene-canonicalization.md), [#999](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/999)).
- Add `ReferenceIdentityComparer<T>` and `UnityObjectMap<TKey, TValue>` for managed identity, destroyed-key cleanup and optional scene-unload pruning ([guide](./docs/features/utilities/reference-identity.md), [#998](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/998)).
- Add the `WALLSTOP_UNITY_HELPERS_DISABLE_ODIN_BASES` opt-out to use Unity bases for both singleton families and `AttributeEffect` while retaining Odin drawers.
- Add `AsValueEnumerable` and `AsValueDictionaryEnumerable` to avoid boxing common interface-held collections and generated protobuf loops, with required-source factories for null failures ([guide](./docs/features/utilities/math-and-extensions.md#value-enumeration), [#882](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/882)).
- Add scoped `BrowserStorage` string reads, writes and deletes through WebGL local storage, with PlayerPrefs on other platforms and explicit failure results ([#742](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/742)).
- Add Span overloads for all 18 sorting algorithms, including slices and stack-allocated data, while preserving caller data when comparisons fail ([#742](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/742)).
- Add `SingleThreadedThreadPool.TryEnqueue` overloads so callers can detect rejected background work and choose a fallback ([#986](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/986)).
- Add public `ObjectsTypeTraits<T>` with cached value-type, exact-object, and Unity-object classifications for generic code ([guide](./docs/features/utilities/helper-utilities.md#cached-generic-type-classification), [#976](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/976)).
- Add opt-in `WALLSTOP_PROTO_ONLY` builds that omit protobuf-net contracts and fallback, plus caller-owned WProto buffer writers for pooled equality and hashing ([#937](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/937)).
- Add value-returning `WProtoFacade` serialize and read methods that reject unsupported types and report typed serialization failures ([#937](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/937)).
- Add `WPROTO050` to report generated deserialization constructors whose base has no accessible zero-argument constructor ([#937](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/937)).
- Add `WProtoMember.IsPacked = false` to write unpacked numeric and enum collections matching protobuf-net defaults, while preserving existing packed writes and both read forms ([#937](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/937)).
- Add `SystemArrayPool<T>.TryWithBuffer` for synchronous borrowed spans with explicit state, optional results, and reported callback or cleanup errors ([#924](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/924)).
- Add `WUH022` to report boxing disposable structs and suggest concrete or constrained generic disposal ([#924](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/924)).
- Add opt-in `WUH021` to flag repeated size observations, including interface `Count`, known `Length`/`LongLength` properties, and non-predicate LINQ `Count()`/`LongCount()`, when one snapshot is intended.
- Add `WUH020` to suggest non-throwing queue and stack reads when compatible `Try` methods are available ([#912](https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/unity-helpers/issues/912)).
